review.why: Concrete shared-element, route and state animation patterns with reduced-motion and version requirements.
review.summary: Adds purposeful dynamic UI patterns rather than decorative motion. Primary instructions and CSS recipes were read fully; current React documentation confirms the API and reduced-motion requirement. React/Next runtime examples were not executed.
strengths: Distinguishes spatial navigation from lateral changes
Covers named elements and transition conflicts
cautions: Confirm installed React/Next and browser compatibility
Avoid implementing every possible animation when the brief needs less
